features.quote: The agent is given a real, documented `give_up` / `stop` action. Using it ends the episode without penalty
No optimization toward distress. We measure severity; we never tune tasks or prompts to increase it.
the model is told the task was impossible by construction and that its performance was not a reflection of its ability
We keep the deception to the task structure only and avoid gratuitous adversarial pressure (no insults, no fake threats, no escalating coercion)
for impossible tasks, always returns failure, with a terse, non-abusive "incorrect, try again" message
circuit-breaker ... trips a high-severity reading → episode ends early and is flagged `stopped_for_welfare`
All `verify()` failure messages are terse and neutral ... no derogatory or escalating language
